policy.runtime_dependency: Every active runtime dependency is tracked in this repository or installed from a pinned public source.
policy.private_state: Credentials, personal profiles, receipts, logs, and live state are never source inputs.
policy.import_rule: Only committed reusable source and portable tests are absorbed; local working-tree state is excluded.

sources.scope: Base tree for the self-contained public repository.
Reusable cloud-browser implementation and tests are absorbed by commit, while legacy specification state is excluded.
The shared agent runner, context packet, token ledger, and portable fail-closed tests are vendored under skills/agent-runner.
excluded: Tests coupled to the source repository's legacy directory layout

sources.repository: Daisuke134/anicca-dais (private source-state repository; not a runtime dependency)
sources.scope: Personal OpenClaw configuration, credentials, memory, and live state remain outside the OSS product.
